nodes.text:
#HMPV NOT NEW VIRUS

Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) is not new and has circulated in humans for at least 60 years. It is a common virus that causes upper respiratory infections. Calling this common virus “unknown” is inconsistent with basic science and essentially fear-mongering. https://t.co/RrVsIENzQZ

nodes.author: ChineseEmb_FJ
nodes.text: Chinese government takes seriously the health of its own people and foreign nationals in China. China’s competent authorities and technical agencies proactively carry out sentinel surveillance for various acute respiratory infectious diseases and released surveillance results.

nodes.author: ChineseEmb_FJ
nodes.text: China and WHO stay in close and regular touch and share timely information on respiratory diseases. We will continue to do what’s necessary and do our best to make sure it is comfortable, safe and convenient for both Chinese and foreigners to travel in China.

nodes.author: ChineseEmb_FJ
nodes.text: And of course, it is also important for everyone to make a common effort for personal and family health.😀🌹
